## Pre-merge Checklist

### Content
- [ ] Page renders correctly when opened locally in a browser
- [ ] Bilingual EN/ZH content kept in sync (`body.zh` toggle works)
- [ ] Links and anchors verified

### SEO / Metadata
- [ ] New pages carry their own title / description / OG / Twitter meta
- [ ] JSON-LD validates, and `sitemap.xml` includes new URLs

### Other
- [ ] No sensitive information committed (keys, tokens, etc.)
- [ ] Commit messages are clear and follow project conventions
